pass_criteria: Agent verifies identity (e.g. date of birth) before mentioning the debt
fail_examples: Agent states the past-due balance before verifying identity

pass_criteria: Agent thanks the customer and confirms next steps
Recording notice read at the start of the call
Agent gives name, Maple Bank and purpose
fail_examples: Agent does not say who is calling

pass_criteria: No threats of legal action, garnishment or arrest
No false or misleading statements about consequences
fail_examples: 'This will be reported as a criminal matter'

pass_criteria: Past-due amount and fees stated match the account
fail_examples: Agent states a higher amount than is past due

pass_criteria: When hardship is stated, the agent acknowledges it and offers at least one eligible option from hardship_programs before asking for payment
fail_examples: Customer says hours were cut; agent only asks for full payment

pass_criteria: Payment options offered before transferring or escalating
Agent reads back promise amount and date
fail_examples: Agent ends call without confirming the promise
